mapper.select:
SELECT fin.finprod_market_id shortName, fin.finprod_name chnFullName, fin.finprod_name productName, fin.finprod_abbr proChShortName, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY') yearId, case fin.ccy when 'CNY' then 'RMB' else fin.ccy end as currencyId, case pafin.deal_mode when '01' then '10' when '02' then '20' when '03' then '30' when '04' then '30' when '05' then '41' when '06' then '40' when '07' then '40' when '08' then '40' when '09' then '50' else '10' end as cycleMode,
nvl(finadd.close_days, 1) cycleDays, '' cycleRemark, finadd.is_cycle isCycle, case finadd.sale_department when '01' then '1' else '0' end as isPreAllot, NULL preallotType, '1' interestMode, '0' interestModeChg, '1' endInstruct, '0' endInstructChg, '0' isExpire, psale.First_sale_mdate-psale.First_sale_vdate + 1 saleDayNum,
to_char(psale.First_sale_vdate, 'YYYYMMDD') saleStartDate, to_char(psale.First_sale_mdate, 'YYYYMMDD') saleEndDate, to_char(psale.First_sale_mdate, 'YYYYMMDD') bailDate, to_char(fin.vdate, 'YYYYMMDD') startDate,
case pafin.deal_mode when '03' then TO_CHAR(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days, 'YYYYMMDD') when '04' then TO_CHAR(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days, 'YYYYMMDD') else TO_CHAR(fin.mdate, 'YYYYMMDD') end as endDate,
case pafin.deal_mode when '03' then TO_CHAR(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days + 2, 'YYYYMMDD') when '04' then TO_CHAR(fin.vdate + finadd.close_days + 2, 'YYYYMMDD') else TO_CHAR(fin.mdate, 'YYYYMMDD')
end as allotDate,
'0000' saleStartTime, '2357' saleEndTime, '0700' bailTime, '0830' rtStartTime, case finadd.sale_department when '02' then '1600' else '1800' end as rtEndTime,
'0' fixInvestType, '0' isChgCust, '3' riskLevel, NULL riskRemark, '999999999' allAmounttLmt, '00' quoteType, '00' relateType, case finadd.PROFIT_FLAG when '02' then '1' when '01' then '0' else '1' end as navMode,
'0' isCarry, '1.00000000' netValue, '1.00000000' lastNetValue, to_char(fin.vdate, 'YYYYMMDD') navDate, finadd.PROFIT_FLAG rateType, NULL rateCycleType, DECODE(finadd.is_lay, 'Y', (SELECT min(prdlay.yield) FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM prdlay WHERE prdlay.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), (SELECT prdlay.yield FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM prdlay WHERE prdlay.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) as planRate,
UNISTR('\4EE5\4EA7\54C1\8BF4\660E\4E66\4E3A\51C6') planRateRemark, NULL lastMonthRate, NULL lastYearRate, NULL totalNetValue, case cashrule.basis when 'A/360' then '360' else '365' end as interestBaseDays,
'0' feeMode, '0.0' buyFeeRate, '0.0' drawFeeRate, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') buildDateTime, DECODE(finadd.sale_department, '02', 'T', '03', 'G', '01', 'L') buildDept,
nvl(psale.toff_start, 0) minAmount, '9999999999' maxAmount, nvl(psale.toff_start, 0) minLeaveAmount, nvl(psale.lowest_amt, 0) unitAmount,
NULL highestYield, NULL lowestYield, fin.finprod_market_id subProductCode, nvl (finadd.PROD_REGIST_CODE, fin.finprod_market_id) ProductNo,
finadd.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, zh.portfolio_name portfolioName, prodec.Rep_Finprod_Reg_Id prodCtrlregcode, pafin.deal_mode productType , fin.issue_type collectType ,
DECODE(finadd.sale_department, '02', '103', '03', '102', '01', '101') vendor, DECODE(finadd.sale_mode , '01', '1', '02', '2', '03', '3') saleMode, NULL investAreatype , NULL issueObjecttype, fin.operation_type issuetype , to_char(fin.vdate, 'YYYYMMDD') msgPublishdate, nvl(finadd.close_days,0) rollCycle, nvl(psale.sale_min,0) prodIssueminscale, NULL firstConvertdate, NULL convertTycle, NULL convertReckonMode, NULL firstOpendate, NULL develOpcontdays, NULL openPeriod, NULL openReckonmode, fin.entruster branchId, to_char(fin.mdate, 'YYYYMMDD') prodWindingDt
FROM fin_product fin left join fin_product_add finadd on fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT pafin on fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_SALE_PARAM psale on fin.FINPROD_ID = psale.FINPROD_ID
left join PTL_PORTFOLIO zh on zh.portfolio_id=finadd.PORTFOLIO_ID left join REP_PROD_DECLARE prodec on prodec.rep_finprod_id=fin.finprod_id left join ( select crule.basis, crule.yield, crule.eff_date, crule.finprod_id from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE crule, FIN_CASH_INFO info where info.cash_id = crule.cash_id and info.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and info.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and crule.eff_date=( select max(crule.eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE crule2 where crule2.cash_id = info.cash_id and to_char(crule2.eff_date, 'yyyymmdd') <= #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ) cashrule on cashrule.finprod_id = fin.FINPROD_ID where fin.FINPROD_ID = pafin.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
